contracts.display_name: Rhinoceros Native Multi Frame Horn Attacks
contracts.actual_behavior: Vanilla melee invokes doHurtTarget which only chooses SLASH30/FLING15 when idle and returns false. Actor tick advances Citadel first, then server current alive target, starts animation distance<actorWidth+3, actual delivery distance<actorWidth+1.5 AND LOS. FLING frames5..8 inclusive; SLASH9..11 and19..21 inclusive: every matching frame calls attackWithPotion, damage=baseATTACK_DAMAGE8 except Raider10, then launch independently. Each frame queries LivingEntity inflate1; excludes Animal, trusted recipient UUID, and primary target, but no LOS/alliance/creative/alive filter for bystanders; damage=max(primaryDmg-5,1), then launch. No single hit latch, accepted-hurt gate or recipient-width margin. Launch rotation180+actorYaw+angle (FLING0, SLASH first-90/second+90), hugeScale=1+nextFloat*.5*scale (primary1/bystander.5). Horizontal strength=hugeScale*(1-recipientKNOCKBACK_RESISTANCE); motion starts from ACTOR delta plus normalized direction*strength, vertical=hugeScale*float.3 unaffected by resistance; sets hasImpulse and onGround=false even zero/negative horizontal strength.
contracts.source_actor: Original registered native Rhinoceros and native recipients; ownership is unchanged.

contracts.display_name: Rhinoceros Native Two Trusted UUID Slots
contracts.actual_behavior: Foodstuff interaction first invokes parent, adds player UUID only when not trusted, consumes item and returns success; first empty slot0 otherwise overwrites slot1. Two-slot list always contains two entries, possibly null; village-wander !list.isEmpty therefore does not prove any trust exists. isAlliedTo trusts recipient UUID or another TamableAnimal owner UUID, else parent. Player acquisition adult/not-love/no nonnull trusted slots, interval80 follow3; Raider acquisition interval50 requires adult. Defense interval10 adult iterates trusted server-resolvable LivingEntities, detects changed hurt-by or hurt-mob timestamp via canAttack; start preferentially selects nonnull lastHurtBy even if the changed timestamp was the other event. No corrected target choice, tame owner or invented permission. Trusted UUIDs stored as native NBT list; loading more than two repeatedly overwrites slot1. ANGRY is presentation driven by target distance<20, no extra damage modifier.

contracts.display_name: Tusklin Native Forced Forward Ride, Contact and Buck
contracts.actual_behavior: Adult saddle mount permits nonsneaking/nonfood if parent did not succeed and animation not BUCK; controlling passenger first Player only if saddled. Current ridden input is constant(0,0,1), tickRidden aligns yaw/pitch*.25, stops navigation, clears target, sprints; speed=current MOVEMENT_SPEED. TameableAIRide goal also clears target/stops path, at speed2 false-strafe; anonymous overrides forward true/backwards false, moves toward rider look horizontal*10; Tusklin is not FlyingAnimal, so Y offset0. Server isVehicle increments local ridingTime; at max60 (Pigshoes foot-slot160) opens BUCK15. At BUCK frame>=5, after prior launch processing, save controlling passenger ID; next tick eject ALL passengers, reset ID, resolve LivingEntity nonpassenger, teleport to actorEye+(0,1,0), then strength=.9 (Pigshoes.4)*(1-resistance); positive only motion=ACTOR old delta + normalized yaw direction*strength, Y=strength, hasImpulse=true. No hurt required for buck. Native setShoeStack is EMPTY: item interaction consumes Pigshoes but does not install feet stack, and NBT load also calls empty setter; gear-derived alternatives remain conditional on actual external feet equipment, not normal Pigshoes interaction. positionRider is current native placement; old riding-offset method is not promoted as active dispatch.

contracts.actual_behavior: Adult AIMelee current alive target; its variable distToEnemySqr actually stores LINEAR distance. Server actor tick current target distance<sum widths+2, frame7 L/R calls inherited Mob.doHurtTarget (baseATTACK_DAMAGE6), ignores result then yaw +/-90 knockback.5 without LOS test. Tongue attack is not native damage: server tongueStickOut>float.6, no ant on tongue, antsEaten<3 selects ant in inflate float2.6; first candidate can be selected WITHOUT LOS, later closer replacements require LOS. Selected ant remove(KILLED), sets tongue and increments recent count, no queen/alliance filter in this actor query. Ant goal predicate excludes queens, adult/not-standing/not-angry/no tongue and interval30, but does not restrict the separate tongue query. Native isInvulnerableTo retains parent OR direct LeafcutterAnt; canCollideWith/push skip ants. Anger timer30..60 seconds updates server, not persisted by this subclass.
